headline: Apple iPhone Duo Supply: No Timeline for Meeting Demand
summary: Apple CEO John Ternus can't predict when iPhone Duo supply issues will resolve. The company is working to get devices to customers quickly. Currently, Apple cannot forecast when supply will meet demand.

headline: Apple Breaks iPhone Sales Record Even Without New Standard Model
summary: Apple achieved a record-breaking quarter for iPhone sales. iPhone revenue hit $57.58 billion, a 17% increase year-over-year. This record was set despite no new standard iPhone model being released.

headline: Meta to End Quest 2 & Pro OS Updates by 2027
summary: Meta will stop releasing OS updates for Quest 2 and Quest Pro by March 2027. The final planned OS update for these VR headsets is v213. Security patches and critical bug fixes will continue until late 2027.

headline: Google Dismantles Botnet From Rogue Android Partner
summary: An Android manufacturing partner created a backdoor in 1.3 million devices. The devices were secretly turned into a botnet. Google has dismantled the botnet and cut ties with the manufacturer, Videostrong Technology Co.

headline: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - Global Release Times Revealed
summary: The remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is launching soon. Global release times are now available for players. Plan your gameplay for the upcoming highly anticipated title.

headline: Bass X Machina Episode 1 Review: Steampunk Bass Reeves Origin
summary: Netflix's Bass X Machina reimagines Deputy U.S. Marshal Bass Reeves. The series adds a steampunk twist to his origin story. Episode 1 review provides insight into this unique take on the legend.

headline: Trent Reznor & Atticus Ross Score David Fincher's Latest Film
summary: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross have composed the score. Their latest work is for David Fincher's "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth". The acclaimed duo continues their collaboration with Fincher.

headline: Resident Evil Now Available Digitally After Box Office Success
summary: The latest Resident Evil film is now available on digital platforms. This follows its impressive performance at the box office. Fans can now enjoy the horror film from home.

headline: Spanish Footballer Jesus de Miguel Dies After On-Field Collision
summary: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, 30, has tragically died. He suffered a serious injury during a Spanish second-division match. The incident involved a collision with a goalkeeper.

headline: MI5 Avoids Contempt Charges Despite Admitting False Evidence
summary: MI5 will not face contempt of court charges. The intelligence agency admitted its evidence in a case was false. MI5 chief acknowledged "serious failures" but welcomed the court's decision.

headline: Three Potential Outcomes for US Midterm Election Results
summary: Explore three possible scenarios for the upcoming US midterm elections. Analysis covers potential Democratic wave or Republican resilience. Understand how Americans' votes could reshape the political landscape.

headline: Home Secretary Refuses to Detail Cost of Care Worker Policy Reversal
summary: Home Secretary Mahmood declined to specify the cost of reversing a care worker policy. The policy reversal drops plans to extend the wait for settlement. The full financial implications will be disclosed at a later date.
